about: SC-8 on transcripts in Claude Code's on-disk shape (2.1.x): batched results, attachment, system, api-request and api-request-blob lines, a hook block, a piped run. Fixture times start at `base`; the test moves them after the store is written.

memories.left_pad: npm test fails with `Error: Cannot find module 'left-pad'`
memories.bare: a bare `ValueError` is not a stored error
memories.plain: Use Postgres for the user store.

repeats.why: the parent was shown the memory, the subagent was not (R10, R14)
the subagent's recall is not the main thread's; the failing result is the second of a batched entry (R12)
the subagent recalled the memory before its own failure (R14)
a workflow agent counts as a subagent; journal.jsonl beside it is not read (R15)
no agentId in the lines: the id is the whole file name after `agent-` (R15)

no_repeat.sess-b: `cat NOTES.md` quotes the error but did not fail (R8); the hook-blocked `npm test` never ran (FR-005); `npm test 2>&1 | tail -5` exits with tail's status, so it is not a failed run (D7, a limit the README names)
